surface C×C: the intersection form on the Néron–Severi space has signature (1, ρ−1), and the resulting

Grothendieck/Deligne). The positivity is GEOMETRIC (intersection theory on an actual surface).

## FINDING 2026-08-24 (cont.) — the cancellation MECHANISM, made explicit (Handle-tier)

Probed HOW `Q = arch − prime` becomes PSD-saturated (`spectral/tb_fingerprint.py` + mechanism run):

**The prime sum fills EXACTLY the archimedean negative modes, mode by mode.** For every one of the
`4a−1` archimedean-negative eigenmodes `uᵢ` (arch energy `⟨uᵢ,Q_arch uᵢ⟩ < 0`, as deep as `−16a`):
    `⟨uᵢ, Q_prime uᵢ⟩ ≈ |⟨uᵢ, Q_arch uᵢ⟩|`   with ratio `prime/|arch| = 1.00 … 1.29`,
so the full-form energy `⟨uᵢ, Q uᵢ⟩` lands at a tiny **positive** value (`+0.006 … +0.05`) — each formerly
negative mode lifted to just above zero. The deepest arch-negative (`−16.10` at a=3) is filled by prime
(`+16.14`) to `+0.039`. The ratio is largest (1.19–1.29) on the SHALLOWEST arch-negative mode — the
marginal, saturation-edge direction.

**The null space is LOW-frequency and grows.** Q's kernel (n0 = 28,50,69,88 at a=1.5…3) sits at mean
basis-frequency-index well below K/2 (e.g. 54.7 vs positive-modes 88.2 at a=3): the smooth / pole-adjacent
(long-wavelength) sector is exactly NULL, while high-frequency test functions carry the positivity.

**Interpretation (honest):** Weil positivity here is the explicit-formula DUALITY itself — the prime
functional equals the archimedean functional mode-by-mode, so `arch − prime` collapses to `≈ 0⁺` on
precisely the directions where arch is negative, and to an exact `0` (null) on the smooth/pole sector.
The Hodge form's single "special direction" corresponds NOT to a lone negative eigenvalue of Q but to
this saturation/null sector (the pole mode, tightest cancellation ratio). So the Spec-ℤ bridge object
must realize the arch↔prime energy identity — i.e. it must BE the explicit formula geometrically — and
the marginality (Λ=0) is intrinsic: the cancellation lands on 0⁺, never with slack. This is the sharpest
statement of what T-c must supply, and it is a positive, verified structural result, not a wall.

**Result:** at δ=0 (true Weil form) λ_min=0 exactly (saturated, κ=0). For ANY δ>0, λ_min goes immediately

damping the primes (heating) can only DESTROY positivity, never buy a positive margin.

**Meaning (honest, not a wall):** this is the concrete numerical face of Rodgers–Tao `Λ≥0`. RH sits exactly
at the ONE-SIDED accessible boundary of this flow family — the forward flow (δ>0 ⟺ Λ>0) moves away from RH
into `κ=2` negativity; the direction that would give slack (δ<0 ⟺ Λ<0) is inaccessible (Λ≥0 proven, backward
heat flow ill-posed). The saturation has NO slack by construction. **Strategic consequence:** flow/analytic-
perturbation attacks cannot manufacture a positive margin — so the productive lane is the one that
CHARACTERIZES the boundary structurally rather than trying to escape it. That is exactly the geometric
Hodge/Arakelov lane (§1707–§1727), where positivity is the Lorentzian index signature itself, not a margin
sought by a flow. Tonight's analytic probes therefore REINFORCE the geometric lane as the right investment,
and pin what T-c must do: realize the boundary (explicit-formula duality) as a geometric intersection
